limitations: Three diagnostic timing rounds; not fixed A/A or ABBA performance acceptance, API timing or p95.
CPU-full and concurrency published results were rerun sequentially after other probes exited; no controlled host-wide idle guarantee.
Thread/process CPU on this Windows runtime is quantized; cProfile is a separate instrumented pass and cumulative times overlap.
Earlier dashboard-only 1628-row exploratory probe excluded; published CPU probes use all five ALWAYS_ON_INDEX_CODES and 2008 rows.
Prebuilt raw leader inputs are outside tracemalloc/input budget; concurrency/slot probes use per-request independent budgets. No global-memory, authority, cancellation or drain acceptance.
Memory boundary events are live bytes and cumulative peaks, not exclusive allocation attribution. Native/RSS and prebuilt raw input excluded.
Slot probe acquires before connection/transaction; production integration must retain existing independent authority/transaction/clock boundaries.
No production code edits, service restart, browser acceptance, commit or push during this analysis.

memory-detailed.scope: Single process-local boundary probe; prebuilt raw input excluded; wrapper overhead; no native/RSS cap or timing claim

cpu-full.scope: Sequential read-only microprobes; three rounds, thread CPU; not simultaneous API attribution or performance acceptance. Scan/compare timed subregions exclude preflight; profiled compare includes preflight and setup. Raw leader inputs prebuilt outside ledger; not memory acceptance.

concurrency.scope: Isolated SQL/sizing/compare CPU probes; each thread has its own explicit read transaction and independent experimental budget; prebuilt leader raw is outside the ledger. Not global-budget, authority, shared-proof, memory or API acceptance. Each stage includes connection, metadata and preflight; scan adds full payload traversal; compare adds full typed equality. Three rounds; barriers synchronize start only.

scan-slots.scope: Read-only scheduling sensitivity probe with eight complete independent metadata+payload+typed-compare operations. Permit acquired before connection/transaction; not wired into flight/cohort/budget lifecycle. Each task retains its own experimental Budget and uncharged prebuilt leader raw. Not authority, global memory, cancellation, drain, availability or end-to-end acceptance. Three alternating rounds, no artificial scan delay.

reproduction.instructions: From repository root at baseline commit, save each source under .pytest_cache/validator-analysis/<name>.py and run separately using .venv/Scripts/python.exe. Requires the existing local frozen monitor fixture; no fixture payloads are published. memory-detailed generates its valid large fixture locally. Never run timing probes simultaneously.

import sys, json, tracemalloc, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from scripts.experiments.global_evidence_large import large_candidate
from trade_plan_monitor.market_index import canonical, models
from trade_plan_monitor.state import projections
from trade_plan_monitor.runtime.market_indexes import DASHBOARD_INDEX_CODES
from pydantic import BaseModel
row=large_candidate()
text_value=row.payload[9].decode('utf-8')
representation=dict(utf8Bytes=len(row.payload[9]),textCharacters=len(text_value),textObjectBytes=sys.getsizeof(text_value),maximumCodePoint=max(map(ord,text_value)))
del text_value
events=[]
def mark(name):
    used, peak=tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()
    events.append(dict(event=name, live=used, peak=peak))
def wrap(owner,name):
    original=getattr(owner,name)
    def measured(*args,**kwargs):
        mark(name+'.enter')
        value=original(*args,**kwargs)
        mark(name+'.return')
        return value
    setattr(owner,name,measured)
for owner,name in [(models.MarketIndexSnapshot,'model_validate_json'),(BaseModel,'model_dump'),(canonical,'_encode_canonical_value'),(canonical,'_verified_market_index_value'),(canonical,'sha256')]:wrap(owner,name)
tracemalloc.start();mark('full.enter')
result=projections._latest_index_records(iter((row,)),DASHBOARD_INDEX_CODES)
mark('full.return');tracemalloc.stop()
report=dict(scope='Single process-local boundary probe; prebuilt raw input excluded; wrapper overhead; no native/RSS cap or timing claim',jsonBytes=len(row.payload[9]),accepted=bool(result),representation=representation,events=events)
Path('.pytest_cache/validator-analysis/memory-detailed.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

import sys,json,hashlib,cProfile,pstats
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter, thread_time
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from scripts.experiments.bounded_benchmark import frozen_engine
from scripts.experiments.global_evidence_scan import COLUMNS,FROM,ORDER
from scripts.experiments.evidence_representation import OrderedScan
from scripts.experiments.global_evidence_budget import Budget
from scripts.experiments.evidence_cohort import Flights,Flight
from trade_plan_monitor.state.index_evidence import RawIndexCandidate,HEAD_FIELDS
from trade_plan_monitor.state.projections import _latest_index_records
from trade_plan_monitor.runtime.market_indexes import ALWAYS_ON_INDEX_CODES as codes
path=Path('.pytest_cache/active-monitor-cpu-implementation/monitor.sqlite3')
before=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest();engine=frozen_engine(path)
with engine.connect() as c,c.begin():
    mapping=c.exec_driver_sql('select mapping_version from market_index_snapshot_head limit 1').scalar_one()
    sql='select '+','.join(COLUMNS)+FROM+' where h.mapping_version=? and h.index_code in ('+','.join('?' for _ in codes)+')'+ORDER
    with c.exec_driver_sql(sql,(mapping,*(code.value for code in codes))) as cursor:
        raw=tuple(RawIndexCandidate.from_values(tuple(v[:len(HEAD_FIELDS)]),tuple(v[len(HEAD_FIELDS):])) for v in cursor)
records=[]
def execute(stage):
    budget=Budget()
    with engine.connect() as c,c.begin():
        scan=OrderedScan(c,budget,mapping,codes)
        with scan.metadata():
            if stage=='preflight':
                output=scan.measure()
            else:
                scan.measure()
                with scan.acquire(scan.preflight[1],'scan') as work:
                    if stage=='scan':
                        count=0
                        for candidate in scan.rows(work):count+=1
                        output=count
                    else:
                        output=Flights(budget)._compare(Flight(('s',),raw,None,None),scan,work)
                        assert output
        stats=scan.stats
    budget.drain()
    return output,stats
# Timed subregions exclude preflight for scan/compare; setup is outside the timer.
def timed(stage):
    if stage=='validate':
        start,cpu=perf_counter(),thread_time();value=_latest_index_records(iter(raw),codes)
        return dict(stage=stage,wall=perf_counter()-start,cpu=thread_time()-cpu,count=len(value))
    budget=Budget()
    with engine.connect() as c,c.begin():
        scan=OrderedScan(c,budget,mapping,codes)
        with scan.metadata():
            if stage!='preflight':scan.measure()
            def op():
                if stage=='preflight':return scan.measure()
                with scan.acquire(scan.preflight[1],'scan') as work:
                    if stage=='compare':
                        assert Flights(budget)._compare(Flight(('s',),raw,None,None),scan,work)
                    else:
                        for candidate in scan.rows(work):pass
            start,cpu=perf_counter(),thread_time();op();elapsed,used=perf_counter()-start,thread_time()-cpu
    budget.drain();return dict(stage=stage,wall=elapsed,cpu=used)
for round_number in range(3):
    for stage in (('preflight','scan','compare','validate') if round_number%2==0 else ('validate','compare','scan','preflight')):
        records.append(dict(round=round_number+1,**timed(stage)))
profiles={}
for stage in ('preflight','compare','validate'):
    profile=cProfile.Profile();profile.enable();(timed(stage) if stage=='validate' else execute(stage));profile.disable()
    stats=pstats.Stats(profile)
    rows=[]
    for (file,line,func),(cc,nc,tt,ct,callers) in stats.stats.items():
        rows.append(dict(file=Path(file).name,line=line,function=func,calls=nc,selfSeconds=tt,cumulativeSeconds=ct))
    profiles[stage]=sorted(rows,key=lambda x:x['selfSeconds'],reverse=True)[:18]
engine.dispose();assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before
report=dict(scope='Sequential read-only microprobes; three rounds, thread CPU; not simultaneous API attribution or performance acceptance. Scan/compare timed subregions exclude preflight; profiled compare includes preflight and setup. Raw leader inputs prebuilt outside ledger; not memory acceptance.',rows=len(raw),inputSha256=before,records=records,profiles=profiles)
Path('.pytest_cache/validator-analysis/cpu-full.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(dict(rows=len(raw),records=records,profiles=profiles),indent=2))
